_doc: C pattern miner constants — controls what gets mined as Known Quantity patterns

kq_threshold.doc: Pattern must appear in this many files to qualify as KQ. Lower = more patterns mined.

max_define_len.doc: Skip #define macros longer than this (avoids masking function-like macros).

comment_words.doc: First N words of a block comment used as fingerprint for dedup.

identifier_min_len.doc: Minimum identifier length before it's a candidate for mining.

identifier_min_freq.doc: Min per-file occurrences of an identifier before it's globally mined.

identifier_mask_min_len.doc: Only mask identifiers longer than this (shorter = more masking, more tokens saved).
